name: めぐる
text: んー！　気持ちいいー！
trans: Hmphー! This feels soo goodー!

name: めぐる
text:
合宿所からここまでの道はだいたいわかったし、
明日は真乃と灯織も一緒に──……
trans:
Now that I know roughly how far this place is from
the training camp, I'll bring Mano and Hiori here
tomorrow and──......

name: めぐる
text:
（あそこにいるの、小糸かな
わたしとおんなじで探検中……じゃなさそう？）
trans:
(That's Koito over there, I think.
Maybe she's exploring the place like me... or not?)

name: めぐる
text:
（急に声かけたらびっくりさせちゃうかな
でもこっそり通り過ぎるのもなんか……うーん……）
trans:
(She'll probably be surprised if I suddenly call out
to her, but passing by quietly is kinda...... hm...)

name: めぐる
trans: (...Yeah, I'll go say hi!)

name: めぐる
trans: ──Hey Koito, hello!

name: めぐる
text: わっ、ごめん！　大丈夫！？
trans: Omg, I'm sorry! Are you okay?!

name: めぐる
text: ノート、濡れてないといいんだけど……！
trans: I hope I didn't get your notebook wet...!

name: めぐる
trans: Whew...

name: めぐる
trans: ──Ah.

name: めぐる
text:
もしかして、それってレッスンのときに
小糸が使ってるノートだったりする……？
trans:
Wait, could that be the same notebook that you
took notes on during lessons......?

name: めぐる
text:
やっぱり！　あのね、合同レッスンのとき
たくさん書いててすごいなって思ってたんだ！
trans:
I thought so! You know, I think you're amazing taking
down so many notes even though it's so hectic in the
combined lesson!

name: めぐる
trans: Ah, sorry for calling out to you suddenly!

name: めぐる
text:
ノート、どんな風に書いてるのかなーって
気になってたのもそうなんだけど……
trans:
While I truly am curious how you took down all
those notes......

name: めぐる
text:
思いがけず小糸に会えたから
嬉しくなっちゃって
trans:
Unexpectingly meeting you out here made me really
happy.

name: めぐる
trans: Yes?

name: 小糸
text: よ、よかったら……ノート、の……中身……
trans: I-If it's okay with you...... Can you take a look......?

name: 小糸
text:
ま、間違ってたりしないか
……確認、してもらえませんか……
trans:
M-Maybe I noted some things wrongly so......
Can you, help check through it......?

name: めぐる
trans:
......!
Yea, for sure!

name: 小糸
trans: T-This part......

name: めぐる
text:
えっと……
あ、もしかしてこれってトレーナーさんが──
trans:
Let's see......
Ah, maybe trainer-san meant this──

name: 小糸
trans:
......!
Y-You might be right......

name: めぐる
text:
あ！　ここ聞き逃しちゃったとこだ……！
このページ、もうちょっと見てもいいかな……？
trans:
Ah! I didn't catch this part over here...!
Can I look at this page a little closer...?

name: 小糸
text:
う、うん
……あ、次のページも、そのときのなので……
trans:
S-Sure.　......Ah, the next page, it also contains the
part from then......

name: めぐる
trans: Thank you!

name: めぐる
text:
小糸のノート、すごく見やすくてわかりやすい！
わたしもこれくらい綺麗にとれたらなぁ
trans:
Koito's notes are so easy to read and understand!
I wish I can take mine so neatly.

name: 小糸
trans: I-It's nothing......

name: めぐる
trans: My gosh, look at the time...!

name: めぐる
text:
ちょっぴり打ち合わせがあるから
わたしはそろそろ戻らなきゃなんだけど……小糸は？
trans:
I have a meeting coming up in a bit so I'll have to
head back soon... What about you, Koito?

name: 小糸
text:
そ、その……
わたしは、もう少し……
trans:
E-Erm......
I wanna, stay for a bit longer......

name: めぐる
text:
そっか！
日が落ちてきたし、気を付けてね
trans:
Ooh, okay!
It's getting dark soon, so stay safe, okay?

name: めぐる
text:
今日はほんとにありがとう！
小糸とお話ができて嬉しかった！
trans:
Thank you so much!
I’m really happy we had the chance to talk!

name: 小糸
trans: ......Take care, on the way back......

name: めぐる
text: うん！　また合宿所でねー！
trans: Gotcha! I'll see you back at the training campー!

name: 小糸
trans: She was "really happy", huh......

name: 小糸
trans: ......That's nice......
